about: Skill tags for execution (stage 2 of docs/EXECUTION.md): what each skill does to the sum of a death, its trigger, area, cast time, interrupt reach, and whether the engine reads it. Drafted by Claude from data/skills.json (wiki, 2026-10-08), reviewed by Denning 2026-11-25 (flagged rows, a 20-row spot-check and every context-only and ignore row). data/skills.json is never edited by hand; this file stands beside it. Keys are in-game skill ids (PvP ids for split skills); names drop " (PvP)" as in interrupt_worth.json.
status: Path confirmed by the engine session, 2026-11-27 (beside interrupt_worth.json; keys the in-game PvP ids). The additions stage 3 needs are in (R-767, R-768), for Denning's review: who each part lands on, the mark for raised damage taken, R-738's snares, ground effects, strips at cast, interrupts on demand, and 31 more skills. Nothing in the engine reads the new fields yet (execution.is_strip reads only "removes").
scope: 608 skills: every skill on 4 or more bars in 876 matches from 7 September to 8 November 2026 (571), plus 6 below that which the catalogue names (Clumsiness, Ineptitude, Wandering Eye, Weapon of Shadow, Spirit Shackles, Visions of Regret); and (R-767) the 7 more the catalogue names (Spell Breaker, Shadow Form, Obsidian Flesh, Earth Shaker, Mark of Pain, Sum of All Fears, Teinai's Prison) and the other 24 of the 25 skills on 4 or more bars in the 1,000 matches from 1 September to 8 November 2026, where the engine's matches start. The rarer ones (about 190 on 1 to 3 bars) are counted and listed by each run. A skill not in this file is untagged and must be reported, not read as doing nothing (R-460).

reads.read: the engine uses the tags when it explains a kill or a death
reads.context only: the engine knows the skill was used but never gives it as a why or a fault

kind.cast: cast_s is the activation in seconds
kind.attack: an attack skill with its own activation (cast_s)
kind.weapon swing: an attack timed by the weapon (R-750); cast_s null

vocabulary.speeds_up: a movement speed boost for the caster or allies: read for flag runs (was a boost used to get the flag in on time?) and for how fast defenders collapse
vocabulary.not_interrupt: interrupts in the game text, but the engine must not treat it as an interrupt skill (Denning)
vocabulary.reads_and_interrupts: reads is about the skill's own effect. Whether a cast of it is worth interrupting is data/model/interrupt_worth.json, read on its own: the resurrection skills are context only here and still on that list.
vocabulary.on: for each part, who it lands on: foe; ally (another ally, or allies in an area that may include the user); self (the user alone). A part that raises its holder's own damage or healing (a stance, preparation, glyph, weapon spell, attack shout or chant) names the holder; damage the skill deals itself is foe, wherever it comes from (Death Nova, Balthazar's Aura, Hundred Blades). A spirit's part names who it acts on. "removes" lists both sides where a skill removes from both (Hex Eater Vortex).
vocabulary.takes_more: true where the user takes more damage while it is up (Frenzy, Frenzied Defense, Primal Rage, and Aggressive Refrain's -20 armour; R-740, R-768). Healing Signet's armour penalty is context, never a fault (R-768): false.
vocabulary.not_snare: true for R-738's snares left out of the snare reading (Dolyak Signet and Seeping Wound are not in this file).
vocabulary.lasting: true where the effect stays at a spot on the ground (storms, symbols, Lava Font, Ray of Judgment, Kirin's Wrath, wards, wells, traps); their area is "in the area". Spirits are not lasting: they are creatures that can be killed.
vocabulary.strip_at_once: on a skill that removes enchantments: true where it takes an enchantment off a foe as it is cast (some only when a condition holds: Gaze of Contempt, Lyssa's Balance, Signet of Twilight, Hex Eater Vortex); false for spirits, wells, and hexes or enchantments that make enchantments expire or strip them later (Mark of Insecurity, Order of Apostasy, Rending Aura); null where the skill removes no enchantment.
vocabulary.interrupt_on_demand: on an interrupt: false where it needs a condition its user does not choose (a condition on the foe, a pet's attack, a preceding attack in a chain, an interrupt that rides on other attacks or lands on foes adjacent to the target); null where the skill is no interrupt.

denning_rulings_2026_11_25: "Cuts healing" is a part of the sum of its own (Deep Wound, Mark of Death, Defile Flesh, Lingering Curse, Predatory Season).
Skills that make enchantments or conditions expire faster count as "removes" (Mark of Insecurity, Tranquility, Featherfoot Grace, Recovery).
Knockdown immunity and prevention is a new part, "stops disables" (Fleeting Stability, Ward of Stability, Aura of Stability, Balanced Stance, "Brace Yourself!").
"You have more energy than the foe" is a trigger of its own (Mind Burn, Mind Freeze, Mind Shock).
Empathy, Backfire, Spiteful Spirit, Visions of Regret, Clumsiness, Ineptitude and Wandering Eye add damage and stop damage; Clumsiness, Ineptitude and Wandering Eye are not interrupts.
Soothing Images and Spirit Shackles stop damage, like Blurred Vision and Faintheartedness.
Lyssa's Haste interrupts any action but the engine must not treat it as an interrupt skill.
Drain Delusions and Power Drain: Drain Delusions is energy denial only; Power Drain is an interrupt only (it takes no energy from the foe). Power Leech and Power Leak are interrupt and energy denial.
Speed boosts are context for kills and deaths, but bear on flag runs and defenders' collapse speed.
Resurrection skills are very important and already covered (res interrupts, numbers): context only here.
Energy skills (attunements, energy glyphs, energy signets and the like) are context only: a failed cast or a stripped attunement may explain a lack of energy.
Ice Spikes, Lava Font, Obsidian Flame, Smoldering Embers, Vapor Blade, Ethereal Burden, Kitah's Burden and Shield Guardian cast in 1.5 s (missing from the wiki sync).
